name: event-calendar
title: Event calendar
description: The person's time: their events on a month, a week, a day or a few days by hours. Timed events stand at their time and share the day side by side; all-day and multi-day events run as bars across the days; a green hairline marks now. Pressed and moved, an event lifts and steps by the snap to another hour or day, a detent each step, and its lower edge changes its end; keys do the same, out loud, in one commit. A failed save glides every event back. Pressing one opens its details in a popover.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/event-calendar.md. SwiftUI: MetalEventCalendar in the MetalUI Swift package.
